reasoning: With 1 clique of size 4, only 4 vertices can belong to a clique, but the problem requires all 14 vertices to belong to one of the cliques. Since 1 × 4 = 4 ≠ 14, this is impossible.
cot_trace: With only 4 vertices covered by the single clique of size 4, but 14 vertices total, there's no way to satisfy the constraint that every vertex must belong to at least one clique. This is unsatisfiable.
